message.content:
**Uno – Quick Overview** | What | How it works | |------|--------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever you decide). Points come from the cards left in opponents’ hands when someone goes “UNO.” | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (red, yellow, green, blue) × 25 cards each (numbers 0‑9 + two of each action card), plus 8 Wild cards (4 Wild, 4 Wild Draw Four). | | **Setup** | Shuffle the deck. Deal 7 cards to each player. Place the remaining cards face‑down as the draw pile; flip the top card to start the discard pile. | | **Turn** | 1️⃣ Play one card that matches either color, number, or symbol.
2️⃣ If you have no playable card, draw one from the draw pile. If that card is playable, you may play it immediately. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses a turn.
• **Reverse** – changes direction of play.
• **Draw Two** – next player draws two and skips a turn.
• **Wild** – choose any color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – choose any color; next player draws four and skips a turn (must be played only if you have no other playable card). | | **Winning a Round** | When a player discards their last card, they shout “UNO!” if they’re down to one card. If they forget, the next player must draw two penalty cards. | | **Scoring** | Add up the point values of all cards still held by opponents: numbers = face value, Skip/Reverse/Draw Two = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | **Next Round** | Shuffle the discard pile into a new draw pile. Continue until someone reaches 500 points. | **Key Tips** * Keep track of what’s been played so you know when you can legally use a Wild Draw Four. * Use Reverse strategically—if you’re playing with an odd number of players, it can skip your own turn! * Remember to say “UNO” before the next player takes a turn; otherwise you’ll get a penalty. That’s the core of Uno—fun, fast, and full of surprises!
